questions.question: The incomes of A and B are in the ratio 4 ∶ 7, and the ratio of their expenditures is 1 ∶ 2. If each of them saves Rs. 4,800 per month, then the income of B is∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Income A : Income B = 4 : 7

Expenditure A : Expenditure B = 1 : 2

Each of them saves Rs. 4,800 

**Concept Used:**

Income = Savings + Expenditure

Saving = Income – Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let the income of A and B be 4x and 7x

The expenditure of A and B be y and 2y

⇒ Savings of A = 4x – y ----(I)

⇒ Savings of B = 7x – 2y ----(II)

Saving of A = Saving of B

⇒ 4x – y = 7x – 2y

⇒ y = 3x

Putting the above value in equation I,

⇒ 4x – 3x = 4,800

⇒ x = 4,800

The income of B is 7x,

⇒ 7 × 4,800

⇒ 33,600

**∴ The income of B is Rs. 33,600**

Expenditures of A and B respectively = 1 : 2

Saving of each person = 4800 Rs

We have to equal differences between Income and expenditure

We have to multiply 3 by the expenditure 

Now, the new expenditure of both is 3b and 6b respectively

The difference in income and expenditure = 1 unit

1 unit = 4800

7 unit = 4800 × 7 = 33600

∴ The income of B = 33600

questions.question: Three numbers are such that if the average of any two of them is added to the third number, the sums obtained are 182, 230 and 242. What is the average of the three given number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum are 182, 230, and 242

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

(x + y)/2 + z = 182

(y + z)/2 + x = 230

(x + z)/2 + y = 242

Adding above three equations,

⇒ (x + y)/2 + z + (y + z)/2 + x + (x + z)/2 + y = 182 + 230 + 242

⇒ (x + y)/2 + (y + z)/2 + (x + z)/2 + x + y + z = 654

⇒ 2(x + y + z)/2 + x + y + z = 654

⇒ x + y + z + x + y + z = 654

⇒ 2(x + y + z) = 654

⇒ x + y + z = 654/2

⇒ x + y + z = 327

Now by using average formula,

Average of these 3 numbers,

⇒ (x + y + z)/3

⇒ 327/3

⇒ 109

**∴ The average of these three numbers is 109.**

questions.question: A boat takes 14 minutes to travel 8.4 km upstream. If the ratio of the speed of the boat to that of the stream is 6 ∶ 1, then how much time (in minutes) will the boat take to travel 33.6 km downstream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8.4km upstream in 14 minutes. 

Speed of a boat in still water : Speed of a stream = 6 : 1 

**Concept Used:**

Speed = Distance/Time 

Speed in upstream = x – y

Speed in downstream = x + y 

Where,

x is a speed of a boat in still water,

y is a speed of a stream

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of a boat in still water be 6x,

Speed of a stream be x

Speed in upstream direction, x – y

⇒ 6x – x 

⇒ 5x

Speed = Distance/Time 

⇒ 5x = 8.4km/14 min

⇒ 5x = 0.6km/min

⇒ x = 0.6/5 km/min

Speed in downstream direction, x + y

⇒ 6x + x

⇒ 7x

Putting the value of x,

⇒ 7 × 0.6/5

⇒ 4.2/5

Distance to travel in downstream is 33.6 km

Using the formula,

⇒ 4.2/5 = 33.6/Time

⇒ Time = (33.6 × 5)/4.2

⇒ Time = 40 minutes

**∴ Time required to cover 33.6 km distance is 40 minutes.**

questions.question: The cost of a car is 300% more than that of a bike. If the cost of the car increases by 10% and that of the bike increases by 30%, then the percentage increases in the total cost of 4 cars and 5 bikes is (correct to one decimal place)∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost of a Car is 300% more than cost of a Bike.

**Formula Used:**

Percent Increased = (New price – Original price)/Original Price × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost of a bike be Rs. 100

Cost of a car be 300% more than 100

⇒ Cost of car = 100 + 300% of 100

⇒ Cost of car = 100 + 300

⇒ Cost of car = 400

Now the cost of Car increased by 10%

New cost of Car = 110% of 400

⇒ New cost of Car = 110/100 × 400

⇒ New cost of Car = 440

Increase in cost of 1 Car,

⇒ 440 – 400

⇒ 40

And cost of a bike increased by 30% 

New cost of a bike = 130% of 100

⇒ New cost of a bike = 130/100 × 100

⇒ New cost of a bike = 130 

Increase in cost of 1 Bike,

⇒ 130 – 100

⇒ 30

Original price of 4 cars and 5 bikes is,

⇒ 4(400) + 5(100)

⇒ 1600 + 500

⇒ 2100

Increased price of 4 cars and 5 bikes is,

⇒ 4(40) + 5(30)

⇒ 160 + 150

⇒ 310

Percent increased = 310/2100 × 100

⇒ Percent increased = 310/21

⇒ Percent increased = 14.76

**∴ The percent increased in the price is 14.8**

questions.question: Aruna sells an article at a certain price. Had she sold it at three-fifth of that selling price, she would have lost 20%. What is the gain percentage when she sells it at 90% of the original selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

She lost 20% when she sold it at 3/5 of actual selling price.

**Formula Used:**

Gain/Profit = SP – CP,

Percent gain/Profit = (SP – CP)/CP × 100,

Where,

SP is selling price,

CP is cost price 

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be Rs. 100

When she sold at 3/5 of actual selling price he lost 20% on CP

⇒ 3/5 × SP = 80% × 100

⇒ 3/5 × SP = 80/100 × 100

⇒ 3/5 × SP = 80

⇒ SP = (80 × 5)/3

⇒ SP = 400/3

Actual selling price is 400/3

Now she sold at 90% of a actual selling price.

⇒ 90/100 × 400/3

⇒ 120

Now gain = SP – CP

⇒ Gain = 120 – 100

⇒ Gain = 20

Gain % = P/CP × 100

⇒ Gain % = 20/100 × 100

⇒ Gain % = 20%

**∴ Total gain percent is 20%.**

questions.question: The area of a triangular park whose sides are 120 m, 137.5 m and 182.5 m, is equal to the area of a rectangular garden whose sides are in the ratio 30 ∶ 11. The longer side of the rectangular garden is∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of a triangle is equal to Area of rectangle.

Sides of a triangle are 120m, 137.5m, and 182.5m

Ratio of sides of a rectangle is 30 : 11.

**Formula Used:**

Area of a rectangle = l × b,

Where,

l is length and b is breadth

Area of a triangle = √{s × (s – a)(s – b)(s – c)},

Where, 

a, b, and c are sides of a triangle

s is semi perimeter,s = (a + b + c)/2

**Calculation:**

s = (a + b + c)/2

⇒ s = (120 + 137.5 + 182.5)/2

⇒ s = 440/2

⇒ s = 220

Area of triangle = √{220 × (220 – 120) × (220 – 137.5) × (220 – 182.5)} 

⇒ Area of triangle = √(220 × 100 × 82.5 × 37.5) 

Let say the sides of rectangle be 30x and 11x

Area of a rectangle = l × b

⇒ Area of a rectangle = 30x × 11x

According to the question,

⇒ √(220 × 100 × 82.5 × 37.5) = 30x × 11x

Taking square on both sides,

⇒ ( 30x × 11x)² = (220 × 100 × 82.5 × 37.5)

⇒ 30x × 30x × 11x × 11x = 220 × 100 × 82.5 × 37.5

⇒ x4 = 625

⇒ x4 = 5⁴

⇒ x = 5

Longest side of a rectangle is 30x

⇒ 30 × 5

⇒ 150

**∴ The length of longest side of a rectangle is 150m.**

**Given:**

questions.question: A sum lent at compound interest amounts to 72.8% more than itself in 3 years, interest compound annually at a certain rate percent per annum. What will be the compound interest on a sum of Rs.9,000 for 1(1)/(2)years at the same rate, if the interest is compound six-monthly?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum amounts to 72.8% more than itself in 3 years,

When Compounded annually.

**Formula Used:**

A = P + CI

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

Where, 

CI is compound interest,

A is amount,

P is principle,

R is rate, 

n is total number of years

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be Rs. 1,000

Amount to 72.8% more in 3 years

Amount = CI + P

⇒ Amount = (72.8/100) × 1,000 + 1,000

⇒ Amount = 728 + 1,000

⇒ Amount = 1,728

Now putting the value in the formula,

⇒ 1,728 = 1,000(1 + R/100)³

⇒ 1,728/1,000 = {(100 + R)/100}³

⇒ (12/10)³ = {(100 + R)/100}3

⇒ 12/10 = (100 + R)/100

⇒ 120 = 100 + R

⇒ R = 120 – 100

⇒ R = 20%

Now compounding Rs.9,000 for 3/2 years at the same rate,

If the interest is compound six-monthly,

For 3/2 years,

⇒ 3/2 × 12

⇒ 18 months

But compounded six-monthly,

⇒ 18/6 = 3

When compounded half-yearly, i.e. six-monthly,

⇒ R = 20/2 = 10%

Now using formula,

⇒ A = 9,000(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ A = 9,000(11/10)³

⇒ A = 9,000 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10

⇒ A = 9 × 11 × 11 × 11

⇒ A = 11,979

Now for compound interest,

⇒ CI = A – P

⇒ CI = 11,979 – 9,000

⇒ CI = 2,979

**∴ The compound interest is Rs. 2,979.**

When 6539, 7391 and 8882 are divided by the greatest number x, the remainder in each case is the same. What is the value of (3x - 98)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers are 6539, 7391, and 8882

**Concept Used:**

HCF of large numbers is equal to the HCF of difference between them.

**Calculation:**

7391 – 6539 = 852

8882 – 7391 = 1491

8882 – 6539 = 2343

The HCF of 852, 1491, and 2343,

852 = 4 × 3 × 71

1491 = 7 × 3 × 71

2343 = 11 × 3 × 71

HCF of these numbers is = 3 × 71

⇒ HCF = 213 

The HCF of 6539, 7391, and 8882 is also 213

When we divide all the above numbers by 213,

The same remainder is 149

⇒ The value of x = 213

3x – 98

⇒ 3(213) – 98

⇒ 639 – 98 

⇒ 541

**∴ The value of 3x – 98 is 541.**
